_comment: Draft entry for widgets.json in dmellok/tesserae-widgets. Not read by any tooling; it exists so the first catalog PR is a copy-paste. Before opening the PR: drop this _comment and replace the placeholder `release` block with the one the Release workflow prints in its run summary.
name: Outlook family calendar
description: Your Outlook calendar as a family timetable: a column per day, every appointment tinted, patterned and initialled with whoever it belongs to. Signs in to Microsoft Graph directly, so the panel shows the private calendar live rather than a cached iCal feed.
